ingredients.raw: 3 cups protein pancake mix (or pancake mix of your choice)
ingredients.name: pancake mix

ingredients.raw: 2 eggs (could add a 3rd egg if you want)
ingredients.name: eggs

ingredients.raw: Optional add-ins: 1/2 frozen blueberries and 1/2 mini chocolate chips
ingredients.name: blueberries and chocolate chips

instructions.text: Grab a sheet pan (half sheet size recommended) and line with parchment paper.
Pour batter in and spread it, adding any mix-ins.
Bake for 12 minutes, adjusting based on your oven until the middle is no longer raw.
Let cool then cut with a plastic knife.
Store in refrigerator separated by parchment for up to 10 days or freeze (separated with parchment to prevent sticking).
To reheat: microwave a square for 30 seconds (longer if frozen).
